name: Crown Beacon Citadel
core_rationale: Highest apogee citadel town of The Zenith Crown at [1, 1] where white-gold star-lighthouse towers project the airship guidance beam back to Hearthbloom Sky-Spire.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Luminous white-gold fountain basins reflecting the northern aurora crown

North.lock_message: Zero-gravity star-shear along the Solstice Anchor Chain repels uncalibrated gliders; the Beacon Wardens require the Nave Aurora-Key before opening the northern anchor pier.

resident_npcs.name: Beacon-Warden Solenne
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: With the Crown Beacon lit at our 0.60 meter ignition console, airships can now sail directly between Hearthbloom Basin and The Shattered Halo!

resident_npcs.name: Aurora-Smith Lyros
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Our eastern winch-stair now descends directly to Stalactite Plunge Causeway in Perigee Abyss!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors The Zenith Crown at [1, 1], powers the open airship beacon back to Continent 01, and connects East to Perigee Abyss.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: A white-gold star-lighthouse citadel floating inside the highest aurora ring of the Shattered Halo.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Ignition consoles at 0.58 to 0.60m, star-stone risers at 0.14m, doorways 2.25m x 1.70m, and 13.5m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Symmetric West portal to hunting-area-aurora-tether, East portal to hunting-area-stalactite-plunge, Dungeon portal to dungeon-star-heart-nave, and North fog_of_lore portal.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Solstice Anchor Chain behind a fog_of_lore boundary portal and Beacon Warden lock message.
